description: Find where a content-type's relation fields are used by name in queries (populate / filters / where), nested levels included (`populate: { a: { populate: { b } } }`, `populate: ['a.b']`, `filters: { a: { b: … } }`, each level through the relation's target). Pass `field` for one relation, omit it for all. Indispensable before retargeting or removing a relation. Only real relation fields are matched — see coverage.

field.description: A relation field name; omit for all relations.

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

name: find_relation_usages
title: Find relation-field usages
